neighbours.label: the verb or object that announces or holds an organised event in news text ('announced today winners', 'when it holds an annual festival')
fire: The city sports commission announced today winners for its annual awards dinner.
The school will show the project next month when it holds an annual open day.
The club revealed this morning finalists for its yearly photo contest.
The library announced on Monday recipients of its summer reading prizes.
The museum will unveil the sculpture in May when it hosts a spring gala.
Organisers named on Friday nominees for the regional music awards.
The college celebrates its founders each year when it holds a reunion weekend.
The foundation announced yesterday grants for twelve local charities.
quiet: The city sports commission met today to discuss the new stadium budget.
The school will repaint the hallway next month before the winter break.
The club repaired this morning the broken fence near the parking lot.
The library closed on Monday because of a burst pipe in the basement.
The museum will move the sculpture in May to a larger room upstairs.
Workers repaved on Friday the road leading to the regional hospital.
The college cleans its windows each year before the autumn term starts.
The foundation moved yesterday into a smaller office downtown.
